title: Release workflow blocked: GHA cannot create PRs
description:
Failing run: https://github.com/OskarHulter/oh-monorepo/actions/runs/24941927293

Error: 'GitHub Actions is not permitted to create or approve pull requests' (HttpError from changesets/action when opening Version PR).

Root cause: repo-level setting Settings → Actions → General → Workflow permissions → 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' is OFF. API: can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false.

Fix: PUT repos/OskarHulter/oh-monorepo/actions/permissions/workflow with can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true. Keep default_workflow_permissions=read (release.yml already opts-in to pull-requests: write per-job, principle of least privilege preserved). Re-run failed workflow.
close_reason: Flipped repo setting can_approve_pull_request_reviews=true via gh api. Re-ran failed run 24941927293 — green in 21s. Version PR #9 (changeset-release/main → main) now open. default_workflow_permissions kept at 'read'; release.yml continues to opt-in to pull-requests: write per-job.

title: Switch package.json + beads emails to GitHub noreply alias
description:
Personal emails leaked in checked-in metadata:

- apps/website/package.json + packages/{client,server,shared,utils}/package.json (stresslessness91@gmail.com)
- .beads/issues.jsonl owner field (stresslessness91@gmail.com)

Both addresses become public on first npm publish or if repo flips public. Replace with <id>+OskarHulter@users.noreply.github.com (lookup via https://github.com/settings/emails). Optionally add bugs.email field pointing at a forwarding alias for actual contact.

Also update beads owner and any future-author-of-record. Verify with: git ls-files | xargs grep -E '@gmail\.com|@trustpilot\.com'
close_reason: Aligned public-facing author email on oskarhulter@gmail.com across 5 workspace package.json files + the closed beads issue owner field. Commit 0c180c8 on fix/release-action-sha. User accepted that git commit history still exposes stresslessness91@gmail.com (out of scope: would require history rewrite). Going forward, future bd issues will inherit owner from git config user.email — if user wants to keep that off curated surfaces too, set git config user.email oskarhulter@gmail.com (repo-local or global).

title: Document standard feature development process
description: Document Matt Pocock's feature dev process in docs/plans/. README with high-level overview (why-focused, concise), plus dedicated sections for research, implementation, human-qa-of-completed-work, and team-review. Land on dedicated branch + worktree with PR.
close_reason: Docs landed in PR #5 on branch docs/feature-dev-process

value: User prefers lists over tables in markdown docs. Why: stated as feedback on the feature-dev-process docs PR. How to apply: when writing markdown documentation, use bullet lists (with bolded headers per item) instead of pipe-style tables, even for structured rows like step→output→skill mappings or severity levels.
